evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence reviewed during Skill Research Batch 457.
findings: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ180. The user launches an energy slash with a kick and can follow an immediate hit with a second attack; current skill-specific evidence identifies a 2-hit kick/energy-slash sequence with knockdown. Exact damage, follow-up timing, and frame data remain unresolved.
